Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a large bonus when the leftover after placement exactly equals the current item size, so the bin stays able to take one more identical item. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when such a complementary bin exists and is not already tightest. It may help by creating perfectly reusable bins, or fail when identical sizes rarely repeat and the bonus distorts otherwise good fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (80 if r - item == item else 0)) for r in bins]
```
